title: World Bloom — With Your Sights on Stardom, Set Sail! — Episode6 An Unattainable Dream

meta.Event: With Your Sights on Stardom, Set Sail!
meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime's training continues as they each pursue their dreams. When they're called over to SEKAI by Rin and the others one day, they find an expansive new land awaiting them!

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: link_wonder_op3
Wonderland SEKAI
Harbor

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This is the house the zombies were talking about, right? The plushie who can tell us more about that phoenix lives here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I wasn't sure what we were going to do at first, but thank goodness that turtle was willing to give us a ride.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, I'm curious about this plushie. Why would they know so much about that phoenix?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Well, why don't we ask them?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah☆ Hello?!
Any plushies home?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You don't have to yell...
O-Oh, hello! Be right there!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hello!
Oh, you're a lion plushie!

Y-Yes, I am.
Umm... And you all are...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, where are our manners!
We apologize for appearing unannounced.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We're...

Y-Yes, I see...!
You saw that phoenix...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We did! It was so big and cool-looking!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But it took our map, and we're trying to get it back. That's why we need to learn more about it.
I see...

In that case, you can count on me!
I've been studying that phoenix for quite a long time now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really?! Thank you!
Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry!
My name is Rion.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hi, Rion! Nice to meet you!

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line:
Nice to meet you too!
So, let me start telling you more about that phoenix!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, please do!

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Although, I don't have many details on it, such as where it lives or what it does each day.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Come to think of it, none of the other plushies we spoke to had even seen it.

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Yes... It's just that rare a creature.

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: However, I've heard a story before about how it lives on the fabled Star Island and appears in the harbor only on rare occasions.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! Star Island...?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting to hear that...

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Which is why it's beyond incredible how you were all lucky enough to see it!

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Oh, how I envy you so... I've only ever seen it before from a great distance!

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: But you're here to learn more about it. Where could it possibly have gone...?

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: No, first, I should tell you about the rumors and legends surrounding it! That should serve as a nice foundation!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Starting with... How its feathers are said to possess the power to heal others...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Hehe. Rion looks like he's having a lot of fun telling us about that phoenix!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(This must be his favorite subject!
I'm getting all warm and fuzzy inside just listening...!)
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: ...is everything I have on that phoenix!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, thank you very much!
You really do know quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And I get the feeling that you really love what you do.

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line:
O-Oh, I'm sorry!
I didn't mean to get ahead of myself.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No, that was really fun!
You made it really clear that you really love this subject!

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Th-Thank goodness. I'm glad to hear that!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But why do you like talking about this phoenix so much?

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Because...

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: I really admire it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You admire it?

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Yes, so... I've always been very clumsy, and have failed at so many different things.

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line:
I'm also not very athletic.
I always remember being left behind by everyone during footraces.

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line:
Then, one day, I saw that phoenix...
I thought it was so grand and was completely awestruck by its majesty...

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Which is when I decided to learn everything I could about it.

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: And someday... After I've gained more knowledge about it, I want to see it up close and...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Oh, um... This is going to sound really silly...

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: But I want to fly in the sky with it someday...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: With that phoenix?

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Yes. I thought it'd be just so wonderful to fly freely through the sky with that phoenix...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What a super duper amazingly fantastic dream!

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I mean, how cool would it be to fly with that phoenix?! I got excited just listening to you talk about your dream!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too! Me too!

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: But there's no way it'll ever come true, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Why not?

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Because that phoenix only appears once in a blue moon... Also, I can't fly since I'm not a bird plushie.

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: And everyone else has already told me that my dream is never going to come true.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line:
And I know that...
So, I'm sorry. Please try to forget everything you just heard!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rion...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (There were a lot of times when I thought my dreams would never come true...)

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Emu. Keep your dreams to yourself. We're through dealing with you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Shosuke and the others told me to get my head out of the clouds...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Don't give up, Rion!
